changes: Versioned source-specific systemic equivalence catalog: eight corticosteroids, two separate tables, biological half-life and attributed mineralocorticoid activity.
Client-side deterministic comparison in mg using one explicit reference, oral/IV route and single-dose/24-hour-total basis; no patient data, dose selection, mg/kg, mL, taper or interval adjustment.
Adult hydrocortisone adrenal crisis reference and distinct RCH pediatric crisis table, reusing existing accepted regimen quantities.
Adult septic shock corticosteroid recommendation added with SSC 2026 conditional/low-certainty scope and SCCM 2024 common dosing regimen.
Anaphylaxis routine corticosteroid use explicitly discouraged while preserving existing adrenaline pathways.
Pediatric sepsis reference distinguishes restored stability, persistent instability with insufficient evidence, and suspected/documented adrenal insufficiency.
Bell palsy added as subsection bell-palsy of existing ent-emergencies, with five complete clinical domains and a separate pediatric boundary.

Short-course consultation shows the attributed Sullivan prednisolone regimen and the AAO-HNSF >=16-year recommendation; application adult draft boundary remains >=18, with reference/manual review for younger patients.
Explicit eye protection, stroke/Ramsay Hunt/Lyme differential, follow-up and ESE short-course withdrawal context; existing asthma/COPD/croup pathways linked rather than duplicated.

Final review completed the missing explicit 12–17-year systemic corticosteroid band inside pediatric-acute-asthma, preserving separate age bands and clinician dose selection. GINA 2026 Box 9-2 verified directly.

discrepancies.resolution: Endotext 2018 and ESE/ES 2024 remain separate complete presets. No averaging or silent substitution.
Each table supplies its own range. Plasma half-life is not substituted.
Mineralocorticoid values attributed only to Endotext and excluded from arithmetic.

discrepancies.issue: RCH crisis and surgery bands differ at age six
discrepancies.resolution: Only existing crisis table is projected. No automatic age-band calculation or blending with BSPED/surgery.

discrepancies.issue: AAO-HNSF recommendation from age 16 versus application adult boundary of 18
discrepancies.resolution: Both scopes are visible; ages 16–17 retain pediatric/reference/manual handling without an automatically prefilled adult regimen.
Record underpowered 187-child trial and insufficient precision; no automatic pediatric regimen and no assertion that benefit is definitively excluded.

discrepancies.issue: Primary source access limits for Bell studies
discrepancies.resolution: Sullivan dose confirmed in official publisher indexed methods; direct page HTTP 403. BellPIC primary abstract retrieved; publisher PDF HTTP 403. No full-text review of these studies is claimed.
